sources: Understat: historical match-level scores and xG for five domestic leagues
OpenFootball CC0: earlier Champions League results

xgExperiment.features: Prior completed matches only, exclude all fixtures on target UTC calendar day; rolling 365 days and maximum 20 matches; goal and xG scored/conceded, team Elo difference updated only after previous days
xgExperiment.fit: Regularized Poisson regression of goals on log rolling goal and xG attack/defence plus signed Elo difference, per-side intercepts and bounded Dixon-Coles rho; training data only
xgExperiment.select: Selection-set 1X2 log loss, restricted to candidates with no worse selection 1X2 Brier and <=0.002 increase in selection totals/BTTS Brier; never tune on holdout or audits
xgExperiment.uncertainty: Paired week-block bootstrap 1000 replicates, fixed seed 20260927; report intervals, never use them to tune
xgExperiment.runtime: Promote only explicitly accepted leagues with verified current source freshness, identities and xG coverage. Otherwise preserve current model. Cross-competition fallback never receives same-league xG validation by implication.
xgExperiment.blendDefinition: Linear blend of base and fitted expected goals; fitted rho multiplied by the same blend weight, then one shared score distribution.

championsExpansion.features: same rolling goals and Elo; no xG assumed for Champions League
championsExpansion.fit: Same joint score likelihood and regularization, xG coefficients fixed to zero
championsExpansion.parsing: Exclude extra-time/penalty scores and ambiguous records; date-only cutoffs exclude the target day; finals and 2020 August knockout fixtures are neutral.

prohibitions: no future target-match xG as a pregame feature
no held-out or audited outcome tuning
no lowered acceptance threshold after seeing results
no claim that additional data guarantees validation or future winnings
